{"command":"cat >> tig.py <<'PYEOF'

# ---------- Lines and text classification ----------
LINE_TYPE_QUOTED = {
 'commit':'commit ','parent':'parent ','tree':'tree ','author':'author ','committer':'committer ',
 'diff-header':'diff --','diff-index':'index ','diff-oldmode':'old mode ','diff-newmode':'new mode ',
 'diff-newfmode':'new file mode ','diff-delfmode':'deleted file mode ','diff-similarity':'similarity ',
 'diff-start':'---','diff-chunk':'@@','diff-add':'+','diff-add2':' +','diff-del':'-','diff-del2':' -',
 'diff-del-file':'--- ','diff-add-file':'+++ ','diff-no-newline':'\\ No newline at end of file',
 'pp-merge':'Merge: ','pp-refs':'Refs: ','pp-reflog':'Reflog: ','pp-reflogmsg':'Reflog message: ',
}

class Line:
    __slots__=('type','text','cells','data','style')
    def __init__(self, typ='default', text='', cells=None, data=None, style=None):
        self.type=typ; self.text=text; self.cells=cells; self.data=data or {}; self.style=style if style is not None else typ
    def plain_text(self):
        if self.cells is not None:
            return ''.join(c[0] for c in self.cells)
        return self.text or ''

def split_diff_stat(line):
    pipe=line.find('|')
    if pipe<0: return None
    cell0=line[:pipe]
    rest=line[pipe:]
    # binary
    mb=re.match(r'^(\| )(Bin)(.*)$', rest)
    if mb:
        tail=mb.group(3)
        cells=[(cell0,'diff-stat'),(mb.group(1),'default'),('Bin','default')]
        # tail: ' 0 -> 10 bytes'
        m2=re.match(r'^( .*? )(->)( .*? )(.*)$', tail)
        if m2:
            cells += [(m2.group(1),'diff-del'),(m2.group(2),'default'),(m2.group(3),'diff-add'),(m2.group(4),'default')]
        else:
            cells.append((tail,'default'))
        return cells
    m=re.match(r'^(\| \d+ *)(.*)$', rest)
    if not m: return None
    cell1=m.group(1); graph=m.group(2)
    if graph=='':
        return [(cell0,'diff-stat'),(rest,'default')]
    cells=[(cell0,'diff-stat'),(cell1,'default')]
    # plus run then minus run
    i=0
    if i<len(graph) and graph[i]=='+':
        j=i
        while j<len(graph) and graph[j]=='+': j+=1
        cells.append((graph[i:j],'diff-add')); i=j
    if i<len(graph) and graph[i]=='-':
        j=i
        while j<len(graph) and graph[j]=='-': j+=1
        cells.append((graph[i:j],'diff-del')); i=j
    if i<len(graph):
        cells.append((graph[i:],'default'))
    return cells

def is_diff_stat_line(line):
    if not line.startswith(' '): return False
    pipe=line.find('|')
    if pipe<=0: return False
    rest=line[pipe:]
    return re.match(r'^\| (\d+|Bin)\b', rest) is not None

class TextParser:
    def __init__(self, cfg, viewname='pager', insert_refs=False, repo=None):
        self.cfg=cfg; self.viewname=viewname; self.insert_refs=insert_refs; self.repo=repo
        self.in_stat=False
        self.in_commit_header=False
        self.after_commit_blank=False
        self.subject_done=False
        self.current_commit=None
        self.current_file=None; self.current_file_old=None
        self.old_lineno=0; self.new_lineno=0
        self.combined=False
        self.prev_line_blank=True
    def feed(self, raw):
        """Return list[Line] (may include inserted Refs line after commit)."""
        line_text=raw.rstrip('\n')
        if line_text.endswith('\r'): line_text=line_text[:-1]
        out=[]
        # context tracking before classify for file/commit where possible in classify
        ln=self.classify(line_text)
        out.append(ln)
        if self.insert_refs and ln.type=='commit' and self.repo is not None and self.current_commit:
            refs=self.repo.refs_for_commit(self.current_commit,self.cfg)
            if refs:
                txt='Refs: '+', '.join(s for s,r in refs)
                rln=Line('pp-refs',txt,cells=[(txt,'pp-refs')],data=dict(ln.data),style='pp-refs')
                out.append(rln)
        self.prev_line_blank=(line_text=='')
        return out
    def classify(self, text):
        data={}
        # update diff line numbers for content lines later based on prefix; fill below
        typ='default'; style='default'; cells=None
        # subject override detection
        is_subject=False
        if self.in_commit_header and text=='':
            self.after_commit_blank=True
        elif self.after_commit_blank and text!='' and not self.subject_done:
            is_subject=True; self.subject_done=True; self.after_commit_blank=False; self.in_commit_header=False
        # diff stat region / detection
        if text=='---':
            typ='diff-start'; style='diff-start'; self.in_stat=True
            cells=[(text,style)]
        elif self.in_stat and is_diff_stat_line(text):
            typ='diff-stat'; style='diff-stat'; cells=split_diff_stat(text)
            # filename context
            fn=text[:text.find('|')].strip()
            if fn: self.current_file=fn; self.current_file_old=fn
        elif self.in_stat and re.match(r'^\s*\d+ files? changed',text):
            typ='default'; self.in_stat=False; cells=[(text,'default')]
        elif text.startswith('commit '):
            typ='commit'; style='commit'
            m=re.match(r'^commit\s+([0-9a-fA-F]{7,64})',text)
            if m: self.current_commit=m.group(1)
            self.in_commit_header=True; self.after_commit_blank=False; self.subject_done=False; self.in_stat=False; self.combined=False
            cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('tree '): typ='tree'; style='tree'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('parent '): typ='parent'; style='parent'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('author '): typ='author'; style='author'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('committer '): typ='committer'; style='committer'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('Reflog message: '): typ='pp-reflogmsg'; style='pp-reflogmsg'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('Reflog: '): typ='pp-reflog'; style='pp-reflog'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('Merge: '): typ='pp-merge'; style='pp-merge'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('Refs: '): typ='pp-refs'; style='pp-refs'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('diff --'):
            typ='diff-header'; style='diff-header'; cells=[(text,style)]; self.in_stat=False
            self.combined=('diff --cc' in text or 'diff --combined' in text)
            # parse filenames
            # diff --git a/path b/path (paths may contain spaces if quoted by git; naive last b/)
            mg=re.match(r'^diff --git a/(.*) b/(.*)$',text)
            if mg:
                self.current_file_old=mg.group(1); self.current_file=mg.group(2)
            else:
                mc=re.match(r'^diff --(?:cc|combined) (.*)$',text)
                if mc: self.current_file=mc.group(1); self.current_file_old=mc.group(1)
        elif text.startswith('index '): typ='diff-index'; style='diff-index'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('old mode '): typ='diff-oldmode'; style='diff-oldmode'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('new mode '): typ='diff-newmode'; style='diff-newmode'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('new file mode '): typ='diff-newfmode'; style='diff-newfmode'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('deleted file mode '): typ='diff-delfmode'; style='diff-delfmode'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('similarity '): typ='diff-similarity'; style='diff-similarity'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('--- '):
            typ='diff-del-file'; style='diff-del-file'; cells=[(text,style)]
            p=text[4:]
            if p.startswith('a/'): self.current_file_old=p[2:]
        elif text.startswith('+++ '):
            typ='diff-add-file'; style='diff-add-file'; cells=[(text,style)]
            p=text[4:]
            if p.startswith('b/'): self.current_file=p[2:]
        elif re.match(r'^@{2,} ',text) or re.match(r'^@{2,}',text):
            typ='diff-chunk'; style='diff-chunk'
            m=re.match(r'^(@{2,} .*? @{2,})(.*)$',text)
            if m: cells=[(m.group(1),'diff-chunk'),(m.group(2),'diff-stat')]
            else: cells=[(text,'diff-chunk'),('','diff-stat')]
            # parse ranges: last + range is new, first/others old
            ranges=re.findall(r'([+-])(\d+)',text)
            olds=[int(n) for sgn,n in ranges if sgn=='-']; news=[int(n) for sgn,n in ranges if sgn=='+']
            if olds: self.old_lineno=olds[0]
            if news: self.new_lineno=news[0]
            if text.startswith('@@@'): self.combined=True
        elif text.startswith('\\ No newline at end of file'):
            typ='diff-no-newline'; style='diff-no-newline'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif is_diff_stat_line(text) and (self.prev_line_blank or self.viewname in ('log','diff')) and not is_subject:
            # Stat outside explicit ---: only when previous blankish context (log) - for diff/log views the stat follows message; also previous line may be stat handled by in_stat
            # To avoid misclassifying arbitrary pager lines, require prev blank for pager, but for log/diff also if we are after a commit (current_commit)
            if self.viewname=='pager' and not self.prev_line_blank:
                typ='default'; cells=[(text,'default')]
            else:
                typ='diff-stat'; style='diff-stat'; cells=split_diff_stat(text); self.in_stat=True
                fn=text[:text.find('|')].strip()
                if fn: self.current_file=fn; self.current_file_old=fn
        elif text.startswith('+'):
            typ='diff-add'; style='diff-add'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif text.startswith('-'):
            typ='diff-del'; style='diff-del'; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif self.combined and len(text)>=2 and text[0]==' ' and text[1] in '+-':
            typ='diff-add2' if text[1]=='+' else 'diff-del2'; style=typ; cells=[(text,style)]
        elif is_subject:
            typ='default'; style='default'; cells=[(text,style)]
        else:
            # custom quoted / regex rules in order
            found=None
            for key in self.cfg.color_order:
                if key[0]!='str': continue
                pat=key[1]
                # skip patterns already corresponding to builtin prefix types handled above
                if pat in LINE_TYPE_QUOTED.values(): continue
                if len(pat)>=2 and pat.startswith('/') and pat.endswith('/'):
                    try:
                        if re.search(pat[1:-1],text): found=key; break
                    except Exception: pass
                elif pat and text.startswith(pat):
                    found=key; break
            if found is not None:
                typ=''; style=('str',found[1]); cells=[(text,style)]
            else:
                typ='default'; style='default'; cells=[(text,style)]
        # Fill browsing-state data
        data['commit']=self.current_commit
        data['file']=self.current_file
        data['file_old']=self.current_file_old
        # line numbers in diff
        if typ=='diff-chunk':
            data['lineno']=self.new_lineno; data['lineno_old']=self.old_lineno
        elif typ=='diff-add':
            data['lineno']=self.new_lineno; data['lineno_old']=self.old_lineno
            if self.new_lineno: self.new_lineno+=1
        elif typ=='diff-del':
            data['lineno']=self.new_lineno; data['lineno_old']=self.old_lineno
            if self.old_lineno: self.old_lineno+=1
        elif text.startswith(' ') and self.new_lineno and self.viewname in ('diff','stage','pager','log'):
            data['lineno']=self.new_lineno; data['lineno_old']=self.old_lineno
            # Only advance in diff hunks: heuristic - if we have seen a chunk (new_lineno>0)
            self.new_lineno+=1

{"command":"cat >> tig.py <<'PYEOF'

# ---------- App: loaders ----------
def _split_opts(s):
    if not s: return []
    try: return shlex.split(str(s))
    except Exception: return str(s).split()

def _transform_stat(args,width):
    out=[]
    for a in args:
        if a=='--stat': out.append(f'--stat={width}')
        else: out.append(a)
    return out

def _app_effective_diff_args(self):
    if getattr(self,'cli_diff_args',None):
        return list(self.cli_diff_args)
    do=str(self.cfg.options.get('diff-options','') or '')
    if do.strip(): return _split_opts(do)
    env=os.environ.get('TIG_DIFF_OPTS')
    if env: return _split_opts(env)
    return []

def _app_word_diff_arg(self):
    if getattr(self,'cli_word_diff',None) is not None:
        return f"--word-diff={self.cli_word_diff}"
    if self.cfg.get_bool('word-diff'): return '--word-diff=plain'
    return '--word-diff=none'

def _app_diff_extra_args(self):
    out=[]
    ctx=self.cfg.get_int('diff-context',3)
    if ctx!=3: out.append(f'-U{ctx}')
    isp=str(self.cfg.options.get('ignore-space','no'))
    if isp=='all': out.append('--ignore-all-space')
    elif isp=='some': out.append('--ignore-space-change')
    elif isp=='at-eol': out.append('--ignore-space-at-eol')
    out.extend(self._effective_diff_args())
    return out

def _app_mailmap_arg(self):
    return '--use-mailmap' if self.cfg.get_bool('mailmap') else '--no-use-mailmap'

def _app_notes_arg(self):
    if self.notes_ref: return f'--show-notes={self.notes_ref}'
    if self.cfg.get_bool('show-notes'): return '--show-notes'
    return None

def _make_commit_line(self, ci, typ='main-commit'):
    ln=Line(typ,ci.title,data={'commitinfo':ci,'title':ci.title,'id':ci.id,'commit':ci.id,'restore_key':ci.id})
    return ln

def _app_load_main(self, view):
    commits=[]; stdin_graph=False
    if self.initial_view=='main' and self.stdin_mode=='pretty-raw' and not view.state.get('_loaded_once'):
        commits=parse_raw_commits(decode(self.stdin_data or b''))
        stdin_graph=True
    else:
        # build git log cmd
        order=str(self.cfg.options.get('commit-order','auto'))
        graph_col=self.column_for('main','commit-title')
        graph_enabled = graph_col is not None and graph_col.opts.get('graph') not in (None,'no')
        order_flag=[]
        if order=='topo': order_flag=['--topo-order']
        elif order=='date': order_flag=['--date-order']
        elif order=='author-date': order_flag=['--author-date-order']
        elif order=='reverse': order_flag=['--reverse']
        elif order=='auto' and graph_enabled: order_flag=['--topo-order']

def _app_apply_describe(self, view, target):
    if not self.repo.is_repo or not view.lines: return
    rc,out=self.git.run(['git','describe','--tags',target])
    if rc!=0: return
    desc=decode(out).strip().splitlines()
    if not desc: return
    desc=desc[0].strip()
    if not desc: return
    # find first commit line
    for i,ln in enumerate(view.lines):
        if ln.type=='commit':
            if i+1<len(view.lines) and view.lines[i+1].type=='pp-refs':
                old=view.lines[i+1].plain_text()
                new=old+f", {desc}"
                view.lines[i+1].text=new; view.lines[i+1].cells=[(new,'pp-refs')]
            else:
                new=f"Refs: {desc}"
                view.lines.insert(i+1,Line('pp-refs',new,cells=[(new,'pp-refs')],data=dict(ln.data),style='pp-refs'))
            break

def _app_run_diff_highlight(self, out):
    prog=str(self.cfg.options.get('diff-highlight',''))

    if prog in ('yes','true'): prog='diff-highlight'
    rc,cout=self.git.run_shell(prog,input_data=out,merge_stderr=False) if False else (1,b'')
    # external program execution traced differently; run directly without trace for now
    try:
        p=subprocess.run(shlex.split(prog),input=out,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        if p.returncode==0 and p.stdout: return p.stdout
    except Exception: pass
    return out

def mode_to_string(mode,typ):
    try: m=int(mode)
    except Exception: m=0
    if typ=='tree': first='d'
    elif m==0o120000: first='l'
    elif typ=='commit': first='d'
    else: first='-'
    perms=m & 0o777
    s=''
    for shift,chars in [(6,'rwx'),(3,'rwx'),(0,'rwx')]:
        bits=(perms>>shift)&7
        s+=chars[0] if bits&4 else '-'
        s+=chars[1] if bits&2 else '-'
        s+=chars[2] if bits&1 else '-'
    if first=='l': s='rwxrwxrwx'
    return first+s

def _parse_diff_raw_z(data):
    """Parse git diff-index/diff-files -z output: returns entries dicts."""
    text=decode(data)
    toks=[t for t in text.split('\x00')]
    # tokens alternate header and path(s); header starts with ':'
    entries=[]; i=0
    while i<len(toks):
        tok=toks[i]; i+=1
        if not tok: continue
        if not tok.startswith(':'):
            continue
        parts=tok.split()
        # :srcmode dstmode srcsha dstsha STATUS[score]
        if len(parts)<5: continue
        status_full=parts[4]
        status=status_full[0]
        paths=[]
        npaths=2 if status in 'RC' else 1
        for _ in range(npaths):
            if i<len(toks): paths.append(toks[i]); i+=1
        entries.append({'status':status,'status_full':status_full,'file':paths[-1] if paths else '','file_old':paths[0] if len(paths)>1 else (paths[0] if paths else ''),'src_mode':parts[0][1:],'dst_mode':parts[1]})
    return entries

def mode_to_string(mode,typ):
    try: m=int(mode)

    if typ=='tree': first='d'

    elif typ=='commit': first='d'
    else: first='-'
    perms=m & 0o777
    s=''
    for shift,chars in [(6,'rwx'),(3,'rwx'),(0,'rwx')]:

            ln.data['position_label']=f"file {nfile} of {total_files}"
    # header view_ref: selected first entry normally gives title; but if header selected, original? The view starts at lineno 1, header ref is tree id of first entry in captured save-view (because selected line 1, not header). If user moves to header, ref likely current directory tree id? Set to commit tree id if known from state
    lines[0].data['view_ref']=view.state.get('tree_id','') or (entries[0]['id'] if entries and path=='' else '')
    view.lines=lines
    if not view.state.get('_pos_init'):
        view.lineno=1 if len(lines)>1 else 0
        view.state['_pos_init']=True

def lines_ref_for_tree_header(view,entries):
    return ''

def mode_to_string(mode,typ):
    try: m=int(mode)
    except Exception: m=0
    if typ=='tree': first='d'
    elif m==0o120000: first='l'
    elif typ=='commit': first='d'
    else: first='-'
    perms=m & 0o777
    s=''
    for shift,chars in [(6,'rwx'),(3,'rwx'),(0,'rwx')]:
        bits=(perms>>shift)&7
        s+=chars[0] if bits&4 else '-'
        s+=chars[1] if bits&2 else '-'
        s+=chars[2] if bits&1 else '-'
    if first=='l': s='rwxrwxrwx'
    return first+s

def _read_local_file_lines(self, view, filepath, blobid=None):
    """Load a file from worktree (filepath relative to cwd/repo prefix) or blob id, running check-attr/file like original."""
    lines=[]
    # git check-attr and file --mime trace commands (only if repo?)
    mime=''
    if filepath:
        self.git.run(['git','check-attr','encoding','--',filepath])
        rc,out=self.git.run(['file','--mime','--',filepath])
        mime=decode(out)
    data=None
    if blobid:
        rc,out=self.git.run(['git','cat-file','blob',blobid])
        data=out
    elif filepath:
        try:
            with open(filepath,'rb') as f: data=f.read()
        except Exception:
            data=b''
    text=decode(data or b'')
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        lines.append(Line('default',raw,cells=[(raw,'default')],data={'file':filepath}))
    return lines

def _app_load_blob(self, view):
    filepath=view.state.get('file','')
    blobid=view.state.get('blob')
    view.state['fallback_ref']=filepath
    view.lines=self._read_local_file_lines(view,filepath,blobid)

def _parse_diff_raw_z(data):
    """Parse git diff-index/diff-files -z output: returns entries dicts."""
    text=decode(data)
    toks=[t for t in text.split('\x00')]
    # tokens alternate header and path(s); header starts with ':'
    entries=[]; i=0
    while i<len(toks):
        tok=toks[i]; i+=1
        if not tok: continue
        if not tok.startswith(':'):
            continue
        parts=tok.split()
        # :srcmode dstmode srcsha dstsha STATUS[score]
        if len(parts)<5: continue
        status_full=parts[4]
        status=status_full[0]
        paths=[]
        npaths=2 if status in 'RC' else 1
        for _ in range(npaths):
            if i<len(toks): paths.append(toks[i]); i+=1
        entries.append({'status':status,'status_full':status_full,'file':paths[-1] if paths else '','file_old':paths[0] if len(paths)>1 else (paths[0] if paths else ''),'src_mode':parts[0][1:],'dst_mode':parts[1]})
    return entries

def _app_load_status(self, view):
    self.git.run(['git','update-index','-q','--unmerged','--refresh'])
    staged=[]
    if self.repo.head_id:
        rc,out=self.git.run(['git','diff-index','-z','--diff-filter=ACDMRTXB','-C','--cached','HEAD','--'])
        staged=_parse_diff_raw_z(out)
    else:
        rc,out=self.git.run(['git','ls-files','-z','--cached','--exclude-standard'])
        for p in decode(out).split('\x00'):
            if p: staged.append({'status':'A','file':p,'file_old':p})
    rc,out=self.git.run(['git','diff-files','-z'])
    unstaged=_parse_diff_raw_z(out)
    untracked=[]
    if self.cfg.get_bool('status-show-untracked-files'):
        rc,out=self.git.run(['git','ls-files','-z','--others','--exclude-standard'])
        for p in decode(out).split('\x00'):
            if p: untracked.append({'status':'?','file':p,'file_old':p})
    # Header
    if not self.repo.head_id and self.repo.is_repo:
        header='Initial commit'
    elif self.repo.head_branch:
        header=f"On branch {self.repo.head_branch}"
    elif self.repo.head_id:
        header='HEAD detached'  # refined later if needed
    else:
        header='Initial commit'
    lines=[]
    lines.append(Line('header','',data={'text_override':header,'override_style':'header','view_ref':'Nothing to update','restore_key':'__header__'}))
    sections=[('stat-staged','Changes to be committed:',staged,'staged'),('stat-unstaged','Changes not staged for commit:',unstaged,'unstaged'),('stat-untracked','Untracked files:',untracked,'untracked')]
    # u key display
    ukey='u'
    for b in self.cfg.bindings:
        if b.keymap in ('status','generic') and b.action=='status-update': ukey=token_help_name(b.token); break
    for typ,title,entries,cat in sections:
        if entries:
            if cat=='staged': ref=f"Press {ukey} to unstage all files for commit"
            elif cat=='unstaged': ref=f"Press {ukey} to stage all files for commit"
            else: ref=f"Press {ukey} to stage all files for addition"
        else: ref='Nothing to update'
        lines.append(Line(typ,'',data={'text_override':title,'override_style':typ,'view_ref':ref,'restore_key':'__sec_'+cat,'status_section':cat,'section_entries':entries}))
        if not entries:
            lines.append(Line(typ,'',data={'text_override':'  (no files)','override_style':typ,'view_ref':'Nothing to update','restore_key':'__nofiles_'+cat,'status_section':cat}))
        for e in entries:
            fn=e.get('file','')
            if cat=='staged': ref=f"Press {ukey} to unstage '{fn}' for commit"
            elif cat=='unstaged': ref=f"Press {ukey} to stage '{fn}' for commit"
            else: ref=f"Press {ukey} to stage '{fn}' for addition"
            ln=Line(typ,fn,data={'status_char':e.get('status','?'),'file_name':fn,'filename':fn,'file':fn,'file_old':e.get('file_old',fn),'view_ref':ref,'restore_key':cat+':'+fn,'status_section':cat,'entry':e})
            lines.append(ln)
    view.lines=lines
    view.state['staged']=staged; view.state['unstaged']=unstaged; view.state['untracked']=untracked

def _app_load_stage(self, view):
    cat=view.state.get('category','unstaged')
    filepath=view.state.get('file')
    width=view.width or self.screen_w
    if cat=='untracked':
        view.state['fallback_ref']=f"Untracked file {filepath}" if filepath else ''
        view.lines=self._read_local_file_lines(view,filepath,None) if filepath else []
        return
    view.state['fallback_ref']="Press '<Enter>' to jump to file diff"
    if cat=='staged':
        cmd=['git','diff-index','--encoding=UTF-8','--textconv','--patch-with-stat',f'--stat={width}','-C','--cached','--diff-filter=ACDMRTXB']
        cmd.extend(self._diff_extra_args())
        cmd.append(self._word_diff_arg()); cmd.append('HEAD'); cmd.append('--')
    else:
        cmd=['git','diff-files','--encoding=UTF-8','--textconv','--patch-with-stat',f'--stat={width}','-C']
        cmd.extend(self._diff_extra_args())
        cmd.append(self._word_diff_arg()); cmd.append('--')
    if filepath:
        fold=view.state.get('file_old') or filepath
        cmd.extend([filepath,fold])
    rc,out=self.git.run(cmd,merge_stderr=True)
    parser=TextParser(self.cfg,'stage',insert_refs=False,repo=self.repo)
    lines=[]
    for raw in decode(out).splitlines(): lines.extend(parser.feed(raw))
    view.lines=lines

# ---------- App: search ----------
def _app_search_text(self, view, line, idx):
    cells=self.render_line_cells(view,line,idx)
    if view.col_offset: cells=_skip_cells(cells,view.col_offset)
    s=[]
    for c,st in cells:
        if c is None: continue
        s.append(self._glyph_display_char(c) if is_glyph(c) else c)
    return ''.join(s).rstrip()

def _app_find_matches(self, view, pattern):
    try:
        old=self.search_pattern; self.search_pattern=pattern; rx=self._compiled_search(); self.search_pattern=old
    except re.error:
        return None
    if rx is None: return []
    ms=[]
    for i,ln in enumerate(view.lines):
        if rx.search(self._search_text(view,ln,i)): ms.append(i)
    return ms

def _app_do_search(self, pattern, direction=1, start_after=False):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view: return
    pattern=pattern if pattern is not None else self.search_pattern
    if pattern=='':
        # empty search repeats previous?
        pattern=self.search_pattern
        if not pattern: return
    try:
        old=self.search_pattern; self.search_pattern=pattern; rx=self._compiled_search()
    except re.error:
        self.search_pattern=pattern; self.set_status("Search failed: Invalid regular expression"); return
    self.search_pattern=pattern; self.search_direction=direction
    matches=self._find_matches(view,pattern)
    if matches is None:
        self.set_status("Search failed: Invalid regular expression"); return
    if not matches:
        self.set_status(f"No match found for '{pattern}'"); return
    cur=view.lineno
    target=None
    if direction>0:
        cands=[m for m in matches if m>cur] if start_after else [m for m in matches if m>=cur]
        target=cands[0] if cands else (matches[0] if self.cfg.get_bool('wrap-search') else None)
    else:
        cands=[m for m in matches if m<cur] if start_after else [m for m in matches if m<=cur]
        target=cands[-1] if cands else (matches[-1] if self.cfg.get_bool('wrap-search') else None)
    if target is None:
        self.set_status(f"No match found for '{pattern}'"); return
    view.lineno=target; view.clamp()
    ordinal=matches.index(target)+1
    self.set_status(f"Line {target+1} matches '{pattern}' ({ordinal} of {len(matches)})")

def _app_find_next(self, prev=False):
    if not self.search_pattern:
        return
    direction=self.search_direction
    if prev: direction=-direction
    self._do_search(self.search_pattern,direction=direction,start_after=True)

App._search_text=_app_search_text
App._find_matches=_app_find_matches
App._do_search=_app_do_search
App._find_next=_app_find_next

# ---------- App: status/stage mutation helpers ----------
def _app_status_update_entries(self, category, entries):
    if not entries: return
    if category=='staged':
        # unstage via update-index --index-info using HEAD side (src) entries
        data=b''
        for e in entries:
            fn=e.get('file',''); fold=e.get('file_old',fn)
            srcmode=e.get('src_mode','0'); srcsha=e.get('src_sha','0'*40)
            status=e.get('status','')
            if status in ('R','C'):
                # restore old, remove new if rename
                data+=f"{srcmode} {srcsha}\t{fold}\x00".encode()
                if status=='R':
                    data+=f"0 {'0'*40}\t{fn}\x00".encode()
            else:
                data+=f"{srcmode} {srcsha}\t{fn}\x00".encode()
        self.git.run(['git','update-index','-z','--index-info'],input_data=data)
    else:
        data=b''
        for e in entries:
            data+=(e.get('file','')+'\x00').encode()
        self.git.run(['git','update-index','-z','--add','--remove','--stdin'],input_data=data)

def _app_reload_status_and_stage(self):
    # reload visible status/stage/main views after mutation
    for v in list(self.display):
        self.load_view(v)
    self.repo.load_refs()

def _app_status_update(self):
    view=self.current_view; line=view.selected() if view else None
    if view is None or line is None: return
    if view.name=='status':
        cat=line.data.get('status_section')
        if not cat: return
        entries=[]
        if line.data.get('entry'): entries=[line.data['entry']]
        elif line.data.get('section_entries') is not None: entries=list(line.data['section_entries'])
        else: return
        self._status_update_entries(cat,entries)
        self.load_view(view)
        return
    if view.name=='stage':
        self._stage_apply_chunk(reverse=False,whole_fallback=True)
        return

def _stage_current_hunk(self, view):
    # find chunk boundaries around selected line. Returns (header_idx,start,end,file) or None
    idx=view.lineno
    # find header at or before idx
    h=None
    for i in range(idx,-1,-1):
        if view.lines[i].type=='diff-header': h=i; break
    if h is None: return None
    c=None
    for i in range(idx,h-1,-1):
        if view.lines[i].type=='diff-chunk': c=i; break
    if c is None: return None
    end=len(view.lines)
    for i in range(c+1,len(view.lines)):
        if view.lines[i].type in ('diff-chunk','diff-header'): end=i; break
    return (h,c,end)

def _stage_patch_for_lines(self, view, header_idx, selected_content_lines, chunk_header_text=None):
    # Construct a patch: diff header block lines from header to ---/+++ lines, then chunk header and chosen lines adapted.
    lines=view.lines
    patch=[]
    i=header_idx
    while i<len(lines):
        t=lines[i].plain_text(); patch.append(t)
        if lines[i].type=='diff-add-file': i+=1; break
        i+=1
        if i<len(lines) and lines[i].type=='diff-chunk': break
    if chunk_header_text: patch.append(chunk_header_text)
    patch.extend(selected_content_lines)
    return ('\n'.join(patch)+'\n').encode()

def _app_stage_apply_chunk(self, reverse=False, whole_fallback=False, single_line=False):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    cat=view.state.get('category','unstaged')
    if cat=='untracked':
        # u on untracked stage adds file
        fn=view.state.get('file')
        if fn: self._status_update_entries('untracked',[{'file':fn}])
            # after adding, stage view should switch to staged diff of file? original reloads maybe stage becomes staged; approximate reload staged
        view.state['category']='staged'; self.load_view(view); return
    hunk=self._stage_current_hunk(view)
    if hunk is None:
        if whole_fallback:
            fn=view.state.get('file')
            if fn:
                # need entry info for staged unstage (src mode/sha) - lookup from status view state if loaded
                ent=None
                sv=self.views.get('status')
                if sv and sv.loaded:
                    for e in (sv.state.get('staged',[]) if cat=='staged' else sv.state.get('unstaged',[])):
                        if e.get('file')==fn: ent=e; break
                self._status_update_entries(cat,[ent or {'file':fn,'file_old':view.state.get('file_old',fn),'src_mode':'0','src_sha':'0'*40,'status':'M'}])
            else:
                # all files in category: apply whole stage diff as patch? simpler use status lists refreshed via a temporary status load? Use git add/reset equivalent via update-index by loading status state hidden
                sv=self.views['status']; self.load_view(sv)
                entries=sv.state.get('staged' if cat=='staged' else 'unstaged',[])
                self._status_update_entries(cat,entries)
            self._reload_status_and_stage()
        return
    h,c,end=hunk
    chunk_text=view.lines[c].plain_text()
    content=[view.lines[i].plain_text() for i in range(c+1,end)]
    patch=self._stage_patch_for_lines(view,h,content,chunk_text)
    is_staged=(cat=='staged')
    args=['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn','--cached']
    if is_staged: args.append('-R')
    args.append('-')
    self.git.run(args,input_data=patch)
    self._reload_status_and_stage()

App._status_update_entries=_app_status_update_entries
App._reload_status_and_stage=_app_reload_status_and_stage
App.status_update=_app_status_update
App._stage_current_hunk=_stage_current_hunk
App._stage_patch_for_lines=_stage_patch_for_lines
App._stage_apply_chunk=_app_stage_apply_chunk

def _app_stage_apply_selected(self, selected_indices):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    cat=view.state.get('category','unstaged')
    hunk=self._stage_current_hunk(view)
    if hunk is None: return
    h,c,end=hunk
    selected=set(selected_indices)
    # parse starts
    m=re.search(r'-([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))? \+([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))?', view.lines[c].plain_text())
    old_start=int(m.group(1)) if m else 1; new_start=int(m.group(3)) if m else 1
    generated=[]
    is_staged=(cat=='staged')
    for i in range(c+1,end):
        text=view.lines[i].plain_text()
        if not text:
            generated.append(text); continue
        marker=text[0]
        if i in selected:
            generated.append(text)
        else:
            if marker=='+':
                if is_staged: generated.append(' '+text[1:])
                # forward: omit
            elif marker=='-':
                if not is_staged: generated.append(' '+text[1:])
                # reverse: omit
            else:
                generated.append(text)
    oldcount=sum(1 for t in generated if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('-'))
    newcount=sum(1 for t in generated if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('+'))
    # NOTE empty lines in diff are context with a single space in git output, plain text catches
    header=f"@@ -{old_start},{oldcount} +{new_start},{newcount} @@"
    patch=self._stage_patch_for_lines(view,h,generated,header)
    args=['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn','--cached']
    if is_staged: args.append('-R')
    args.append('-')
    self.git.run(args,input_data=patch)
    # reload logic: refresh status state then stage with category flipping if needed
    sv=self.views['status']
    self.load_view(sv)
    fn=view.state.get('file')
    # check if same file still in same category
    def has(catname):
        lst=sv.state.get(catname,[])
        return any(e.get('file')==fn for e in lst)
    if fn and not has(cat):
        other='staged' if cat=='unstaged' else 'unstaged'
        if has(other): view.state['category']=other
    # reload displayed views in display order excluding status already reloaded maybe
    for v in list(self.display):
        self.load_view(v)

def _app_stage_update_line(self):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    ln=view.selected()
    if ln and ln.type in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'):
        self._stage_apply_selected([view.lineno])

def _app_stage_update_part(self):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    idx=view.lineno; ln=view.selected()
    if not ln or ln.type not in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'): return
    start=idx
    while start>0 and view.lines[start-1].type in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'): start-=1
    end=idx+1
    while end<len(view.lines) and view.lines[end].type in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'): end+=1
    self._stage_apply_selected(list(range(start,end)))

def _app_stage_split_chunk(self):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    hunk=self._stage_current_hunk(view)
    if not hunk: return
    h,c,end=hunk
    content=list(range(c+1,end))
    # split points: context line indices where there's a change before (in current segment) and a change after
    splits=[]
    seen_change=False
    for pos,i in enumerate(content):
        typ=view.lines[i].type
        if typ in ('diff-add','diff-del'): seen_change=True
        if seen_change and typ=='default':
            if any(view.lines[j].type in ('diff-add','diff-del') for j in content[pos+1:]):
                splits.append(i); seen_change=False
    if not splits: return
    # original starts
    m=re.search(r'-([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))? \+([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))?', view.lines[c].plain_text())
    orig_old=int(m.group(1)); orig_new=int(m.group(3))
    # Build segments: each segment ends at a split context and next starts with same context
    segments=[]; start_pos=0
    split_positions=[content.index(s) for s in splits]
    for sp in split_positions:
        segments.append(content[start_pos:sp+1])
        start_pos=sp
    segments.append(content[start_pos:])
    # compute old/new offsets for each segment start relative original
    def offsets_upto(pos):
        old=new=0
        for i in content[:pos]:
            t=view.lines[i].plain_text()
            if t.startswith(' ') or t=='': old+=1; new+=1
            elif t.startswith('-'): old+=1
            elif t.startswith('+'): new+=1
        return old,new
    new_lines=[]
    pos_cursor=0
    for seg in segments:
        start_index=content.index(seg[0],pos_cursor) if seg else pos_cursor
        o_off,n_off=offsets_upto(start_index)
        texts=[view.lines[i].plain_text() for i in seg]
        oldcount=sum(1 for t in texts if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('-'))
        newcount=sum(1 for t in texts if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('+'))
        hdr=f"@@ -{orig_old+o_off},{oldcount} +{orig_new+n_off},{newcount} @@"
        hl=Line('diff-chunk',hdr,cells=[(hdr,'diff-chunk'),('','diff-stat')],data=dict(view.lines[c].data))
        new_lines.append(hl)
        for i in seg:
            # clone line
            old=view.lines[i]
            new_lines.append(Line(old.type,old.text,cells=list(old.cells) if old.cells else None,data=dict(old.data),style=old.style))
        pos_cursor=start_index+ max(0,len(seg)-0)
    view.lines = view.lines[:c] + new_lines + view.lines[end:]
    _postprocess_diff_refs(self,view,view.lines)
    view.clamp()

App._stage_apply_selected=_app_stage_apply_selected
App.stage_update_line=_app_stage_update_line
App.stage_update_part=_app_stage_update_part
App.stage_split_chunk=_app_stage_split_chunk

def _app_stage_apply_selected(self, selected_indices):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    cat=view.state.get('category','unstaged')
    hunk=self._stage_current_hunk(view)
    if hunk is None: return
    h,c,end=hunk
    selected=set(selected_indices)
    # parse starts
    m=re.search(r'-([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))? \+([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))?', view.lines[c].plain_text())
    old_start=int(m.group(1)) if m else 1; new_start=int(m.group(3)) if m else 1
    generated=[]
    is_staged=(cat=='staged')
    for i in range(c+1,end):
        text=view.lines[i].plain_text()
        if not text:
            generated.append(text); continue
        marker=text[0]
        if i in selected:
            generated.append(text)
        else:
            if marker=='+':
                if is_staged: generated.append(' '+text[1:])
                # forward: omit
            elif marker=='-':
                if not is_staged: generated.append(' '+text[1:])
                # reverse: omit
            else:
                generated.append(text)
    oldcount=sum(1 for t in generated if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('-'))
    newcount=sum(1 for t in generated if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('+'))
    # NOTE empty lines in diff are context with a single space in git output, plain text catches
    header=f"@@ -{old_start},{oldcount} +{new_start},{newcount} @@"
    patch=self._stage_patch_for_lines(view,h,generated,header)
    args=['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn','--cached']
    if is_staged: args.append('-R')
    args.append('-')
    self.git.run(args,input_data=patch)
    # reload logic: refresh status state then stage with category flipping if needed
    sv=self.views['status']
    self.load_view(sv)
    fn=view.state.get('file')
    # check if same file still in same category
    def has(catname):
        lst=sv.state.get(catname,[])
        return any(e.get('file')==fn for e in lst)
    if fn and not has(cat):
        other='staged' if cat=='unstaged' else 'unstaged'
        if has(other): view.state['category']=other
    # reload displayed views in display order excluding status already reloaded maybe
    for v in list(self.display):
        self.load_view(v)

def _app_stage_update_line(self):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    ln=view.selected()
    if ln and ln.type in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'):
        self._stage_apply_selected([view.lineno])

def _app_stage_update_part(self):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    idx=view.lineno; ln=view.selected()
    if not ln or ln.type not in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'): return
    start=idx
    while start>0 and view.lines[start-1].type in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'): start-=1
    end=idx+1
    while end<len(view.lines) and view.lines[end].type in ('diff-add','diff-del','diff-add2','diff-del2'): end+=1
    self._stage_apply_selected(list(range(start,end)))

def _app_stage_split_chunk(self):
    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    hunk=self._stage_current_hunk(view)
    if not hunk: return
    h,c,end=hunk
    content=list(range(c+1,end))
    # split points: context line indices where there's a change before (in current segment) and a change after
    splits=[]
    seen_change=False
    for pos,i in enumerate(content):
        typ=view.lines[i].type
        if typ in ('diff-add','diff-del'): seen_change=True
        if seen_change and typ=='default':
            if any(view.lines[j].type in ('diff-add','diff-del') for j in content[pos+1:]):
                splits.append(i); seen_change=False
    if not splits: return
    # original starts
    m=re.search(r'-([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))? \+([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))?', view.lines[c].plain_text())
    orig_old=int(m.group(1)); orig_new=int(m.group(3))
    # Build segments: each segment ends at a split context and next starts with same context
    segments=[]; start_pos=0
    split_positions=[content.index(s) for s in splits]
    for sp in split_positions:
        segments.append(content[start_pos:sp+1])
        start_pos=sp
    segments.append(content[start_pos:])
    # compute old/new offsets for each segment start relative original
    def offsets_upto(pos):
        old=new=0
        for i in content[:pos]:
            t=view.lines[i].plain_text()
            if t.startswith(' ') or t=='': old+=1; new+=1
            elif t.startswith('-'): old+=1
            elif t.startswith('+'): new+=1
        return old,new
    new_lines=[]
    pos_cursor=0
    for seg in segments:
        start_index=content.index(seg[0],pos_cursor) if seg else pos_cursor
        o_off,n_off=offsets_upto(start_index)
        texts=[view.lines[i].plain_text() for i in seg]
        oldcount=sum(1 for t in texts if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('-'))
        newcount=sum(1 for t in texts if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('+'))
        hdr=f"@@ -{orig_old+o_off},{oldcount} +{orig_new+n_off},{newcount} @@"
        hl=Line('diff-chunk',hdr,cells=[(hdr,'diff-chunk'),('','diff-stat')],data=dict(view.lines[c].data))
        new_lines.append(hl)
        for i in seg:
            # clone line
            old=view.lines[i]
            new_lines.append(Line(old.type,old.text,cells=list(old.cells) if old.cells else None,data=dict(old.data),style=old.style))
        pos_cursor=start_index+ max(0,len(seg)-0)
    view.lines = view.lines[:c] + new_lines + view.lines[end:]
    _postprocess_diff_refs(self,view,view.lines)
    view.clamp()

App.stage_update_part=_app_stage_update_part
App.stage_split_chunk=_app_stage_split_chunk

        if b.action.startswith(':'): return 'Internal commands:'
        if b.action and b.action[0] in '!?@<+>': return 'External commands:'
        info=ACTION_INFO.get(b.action)
        return info[0] if info else b.group
    action_order={name:i for i,name in enumerate(ACTION_INFO.keys())}
    for km in keymap_order:
        kb=[b for b in cfg.bindings if b.keymap==km]

        for grp in group_order:

            if grp in ACTION_GROUP_ORDER:
                # order by action definition, preserving insertion within same action
                ordered=[]
                for act in ACTION_INFO.keys():

def _app_stage_next_file(self):
    sv=self.views['status']; stage=self.views['stage']
    if not sv.loaded: return None
    fn=stage.state.get('file'); cat=stage.state.get('category')
    idx=None
    for i,ln in enumerate(sv.lines):
        e=ln.data.get('entry')
        if e and e.get('file')==fn and ln.data.get('status_section')==cat: idx=i; break
    if idx is None: return None
    return _next_status_file(sv.lines,idx)

def _app_after_stage_mutation(self, next_file):
    stage=self.views['stage']; sv=self.views['status']
    old_cat=stage.state.get('category'); old_file=stage.state.get('file'); old_lineno=stage.lineno
    # load status (this also traces status cmds like original)
    self.load_view(sv)
    def entries_for(cat): return sv.state.get('staged' if cat=='staged' else 'unstaged' if cat=='unstaged' else 'untracked',[])
    def has(cat,fn): return any(e.get('file')==fn for e in entries_for(cat))
    used_next=False
    if old_file and old_cat!='untracked' and has(old_cat,old_file):
        # same category remains: select it in status
        self._after_status_reload_select(sv,old_file)
    elif next_file:
        # find next file in new status
        found=None
        for i,ln in enumerate(sv.lines):
            e=ln.data.get('entry')
            if e and e.get('file')==next_file:
                found=(i,ln); break
        if found:
            i,ln=found; sv.lineno=i; sv.clamp()
            stage.state['category']=ln.data.get('status_section')
            stage.state['file']=next_file; stage.state['file_old']=ln.data['entry'].get('file_old',next_file)
            used_next=True
        elif old_file:
            other='staged' if old_cat=='unstaged' else 'unstaged'
            if has(other,old_file): stage.state['category']=other
    elif old_file:
        other='staged' if old_cat=='unstaged' else 'unstaged'
        if has(other,old_file): stage.state['category']=other
    self.load_view(stage)
    if not used_next:
        # preserve stage cursor position roughly
        if stage.lines: stage.lineno=min(old_lineno,len(stage.lines)-1); stage.clamp()
    # reload other displayed views (main etc) except status/stage
    for v in list(self.display):
        if v.name not in ('status','stage'):
            try: self.load_view(v)
            except Exception: pass

App._stage_next_file=_app_stage_next_file
App._after_stage_mutation=_app_after_stage_mutation

    view=self.current_view
    if not view or view.name!='stage': return
    _next_file=self._stage_next_file()
    cat=view.state.get('category','unstaged')
    hunk=self._stage_current_hunk(view)
    if hunk is None: return
    h,c,end=hunk
    selected=set(selected_indices)
    # parse starts
    m=re.search(r'-([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))? \+([0-9]+)(?:,(\d+))?', view.lines[c].plain_text())
    old_start=int(m.group(1)) if m else 1; new_start=int(m.group(3)) if m else 1
    generated=[]
    is_staged=(cat=='staged')
    for i in range(c+1,end):
        text=view.lines[i].plain_text()
        if not text:
            generated.append(text); continue
        marker=text[0]
        if i in selected:
            generated.append(text)
        else:
            if marker=='+':
                if is_staged: generated.append(' '+text[1:])
                # forward: omit
            elif marker=='-':
                if not is_staged: generated.append(' '+text[1:])
                # reverse: omit
            else:
                generated.append(text)
    oldcount=sum(1 for t in generated if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('-'))
    newcount=sum(1 for t in generated if t.startswith(' ') or t.startswith('+'))
    # NOTE empty lines in diff are context with a single space in git output, plain text catches
    header=f"@@ -{old_start},{oldcount} +{new_start},{newcount} @@"
    patch=self._stage_patch_for_lines(view,h,generated,header)
    args=['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn','--cached']

    args.append('-')

        # Closing a view that was opened by switching returns to previous.
        # But initial view may have prev from a former switch cycle; tig view stack roughly mirrors this.
        self.display=[prev_view]; self.focus=0; prev_view.parent=None
        self.layout(); return

new="""def _app_close_view(self, no_quit=False):
    cur=self.current_view

    if len(self.display)>1:
        other=[v for v in self.display if v is not cur]
        # If focused view is the parent of the other displayed view, close both.
        if other and other[0].parent==cur.name:
            prev_name=cur.prev
            other[0].prev=None; other[0].parent=None
            cur.prev=None; cur.parent=None
            if prev_name and prev_name in self.views and self.views[prev_name].loaded:
                pv=self.views[prev_name]; self.display=[pv]; self.focus=0; self.layout(); return
            if not no_quit:
                self.quit=True
            else:
                self.display=[cur]; self.focus=0; self.layout()
            return
        # focused is child (or unrelated): close only it
        self.display=other; self.focus=0
        cur.prev=None; cur.parent=None

{"command":"cat >> tig.py <<'PYEOF'

def wrap_text_line(text,width):
    if width<=0 or str_width(text)<=width: return [text]
    segs=[]; rest=text
    while str_width(rest)>width:
        col=0; idx=0
        while idx<len(rest):
            cw=char_width(rest[idx])
            if col+cw>width: break
            col+=cw; idx+=1
        if idx==0: idx=1
        prefix=rest[:idx]
        # find last space in prefix (not leading)
        br=-1
        for j,ch in enumerate(prefix):
            if ch==' ' and j>0: br=j
        if br>0:
            segs.append(rest[:br+1]); rest=rest[br+1:]
        else:
            segs.append(prefix); rest=rest[idx:]
    segs.append(rest)
    return segs

        commit,file,_=self._context_commit_and_file()

                return

            return

            bv=self.views['blob']

            bv.state['blob']=blobid
            bv.state['file']=file; bv.state['commit']=commit
            self.open_view('blob',split=False,force_load=True)
            _ln=line.data.get('lineno') if line else None
            if _ln:
                bv.lineno=max(0,_ln-1); bv.clamp()
        else:
            fv=self.views['finder']; fv.state['commit']=commit; fv.state['filter']=''; fv.state['return_view']=cur.name if cur else 'main'; fv.lineno=0

            self.mode='finder'
        return

# blame positioning after open: in blame branch self.open_view(...); return -- position by result lineno. Replace that occurrence in blame section
s=s.replace("        bv.state['file']=file; bv.state['rev']=rev; bv.state['history']=[]\n        self.open_view('blame',split=False,force_load=True); return", "        bv.state['file']=file; bv.state['rev']=rev; bv.state['history']=[]\n        self.open_view('blame',split=False,force_load=True)\n        _want=line.data.get('lineno') if line else None\n        if _want:\n            for _i,_l in enumerate(bv.lines):\n                if _l.data.get('result_lineno')==_want: bv.lineno=_i; bv.clamp(); break\n        return")

def _app_update_options_status(self):
    idx=self.options_index % len(TOGGLES)
    key,name,desc=TOGGLES[idx]
    short=desc[len('Toggle '):] if desc.startswith('Toggle ') else desc
    left=f"Toggle option {short} [{key}]"
    right=f"({idx+1} of {len(TOGGLES)})"
    w=self.screen_w
    self.status_message=left+' '*(max(1,w-len(left)-len(right)))+right

def _app_switch_view(self,name):
    cur=self.current_view

    if name=='diff':

        commit,file,_=self._context_commit_and_file()
        # if current line is pseudo, context commit returns HEAD but original did nothing for tree on pseudo; check
        line=cur.selected() if cur else None
        if line and line.data.get('pseudo'):
            return
        tv=self.views['tree']
        changed=tv.state.get('commit')!=commit
        tv.state['commit']=commit
        if changed:
            tv.state['path']=''; tv.state['_pos_init']=False; tv.state['history']=[]

            if cur.name=='tree' and line.data.get('entry_type')=='blob': blobid=line.data.get('id')
            if blobid: bv.state['blob']=blobid
            else: bv.state['blob']=None

            self.set_status(f":set {name} = {ns}")

        if kind=='int':
            cur=self.cfg.get_int(name,0)
            if args:

                    dv=int(args); new=cur+dv if args.strip()[0] in '+-' else dv

def _app_load_view(self, view, preserve=True):
    # preserve selected restore key / line index
    old_key=None; old_lineno=view.lineno; had_loaded=view.loaded
    if preserve and had_loaded:
        sel=view.selected()
        if sel is not None: old_key=sel.data.get('restore_key')
    loader={
        'main':self.load_main,'log':self.load_log,'diff':self.load_diff,'reflog':self.load_reflog,
        'refs':self.load_refs,'tree':self.load_tree,'blob':self.load_blob,'status':self.load_status,
        'stage':self.load_stage,'stash':self.load_stash,'blame':self.load_blame,'grep':self.load_grep,
        'pager':self.load_pager,'help':self.load_help,'finder':self.load_finder,
    }.get(view.name)
    if loader:
        loader(view)
    view.loaded=True; view.state['_loaded_once']=True
    for _i,_ln in enumerate(view.lines): _ln.data['_orig_index']=_i
    # initial positioning
    if not preserve:
        view.lineno=0; view.offset=0; view.col_offset=0
    if not had_loaded:
        if self.select_line and view is self.views.get(self.initial_view):
            try: view.lineno=max(0,min(int(self.select_line)-1,len(view.lines)-1)) if view.lines else 0
            except Exception: pass
        elif view.name=='tree':
            pass # loader set 1
        elif self.cfg.get_bool('start-on-head') and view.name in ('main','log','reflog'):
            # find HEAD commit line
            for i,ln in enumerate(view.lines):
                if (ln.data.get('commit')==self.repo.head_id) or (ln.data.get('commitinfo') and ln.data['commitinfo'].id==self.repo.head_id):
                    view.lineno=i; break
    else:
        # restore by key
        restored=False
        if old_key is not None:
            for i,ln in enumerate(view.lines):
                if ln.data.get('restore_key')==old_key:
                    view.lineno=i; restored=True; break
        if not restored:
            view.lineno=old_lineno
    view.clamp()
    _sel=view.selected()
    if _sel is not None: _sel.selected_flag=True
    self.invalidate(view)

App.load_view=_app_load_view

def _app_open_stage_for(self, split=False, category=None, file=None, file_old=None, entry=None):
    # Determine from current line if not given
    cur=self.current_view; line=cur.selected() if cur else None
    if category is None:
        if line and line.data.get('pseudo')=='stat-staged': category='staged'
        elif line and line.data.get('pseudo')=='stat-unstaged': category='unstaged'
        elif line and line.data.get('status_section'): category=line.data['status_section']
        else:
            self.set_status('')

    if category=='untracked' and not file:

    sv=self.views['stage']

Implemented a full from-scratch reimplementation of Tig in `tig.py`, including:

- CLI parsing, help/version, `-C`, subcommands and error handling
- Main, log, diff, blame, tree, blob, refs, status, stage, stash, grep, pager, reflog, help and finder views
- Git command integration, repository/reference parsing and revision graph rendering
- ncurses rendering, colours, split views, navigation, search and prompts
- `tigrc` and Git configuration parsing, keybindings, options, colours and toggles
- `TIG_SCRIPT`, trace, save-display, save-view and save-options support
- Status/stage operations including staging, unstaging, chunk/line/part staging and reverting
- External commands, editor integration and browsing-state expansion
- Pager/stdin modes and word-diff/wrapping support

Added an executable `compile.sh` that builds `./executable` from the new source and verified it with extensive black-box comparisons against the original binary using scripted terminal sessions, tmux interaction, and multiple Git repositories.
